name: The Jazz Room: A Journey to the Heart of New Orleans
description: Live hot jazz at Hot Five Jazz&Blues Club, with New Orleans classics and improvisation from the Late Jazz Quintet. Saturday 14 November at 20:00, tickets from €19.35.
longDescription:
The Jazz Room goes back to the early jazz of New Orleans. The bar is styled on 1920s New Orleans. The Late Jazz Quintet plays a mix of chosen classics and spontaneous improvisation, with saxophone, trumpet and vocals, and a sound that draws on ragtime, brass and blues.

The programme includes St. James Infirmary, When The Saints Go Marching In, On the Sunny Side of the Street, Basin Street Blues and Hello, Dolly, plus other songs. The show lasts one hour and you can order a cocktail at the bar.

It's on Saturday 14 November at 20:00 at Hot Five Jazz&Blues Club, Rua de Guerra Junqueiro 495. Tickets from €19.35. The show is for over-18s only, and the venue isn't accessible for people with reduced mobility. Tables are shared, and seats go to whoever arrives first. Part of the room is standing, so a seat isn't guaranteed. Arrive early if you want to sit.
